items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Zep was a nice clarinet player, but he didn't play nothing hot.

ctx.x: And, ! What's that little humpback fella name? Who's Kinter Zep? Uh, Pills? It's Pills, yeah. Pills. He played in the street?
Yeah, Pills. He played in the street?
